addCredentialModal.title: Add credential
addCredentialModal.description: Add an API key or token to let tools and integrations use it.

slackSetupTokensStep.instructions: On Slack's confirmation screen, expand <credentials>Your app credentials</credentials> and copy both tokens.
slackSetupTokensStep.skipNotice: That screen also offers a command-line walkthrough and a <download>Download app files</download> button. Skip both. They set up a separate local app, and this assistant needs only the two tokens.

slackSetupOpenStep.body: Open Slack in a new tab to create the app, then come back here for the steps to follow.
slackSetupOpenStep.manifestCopiedNotice: You copied this app's manifest here. If you have copied anything since, copy it again before you paste.
slackSetupOpenStep.manifestNotCopiedNotice: You have not copied this app's manifest yet. Slack's create-app modal has no other way to get it, so copy it before you paste.

telegramSetupConnectStep.instructions: Paste the token from BotFather's reply. It is the whole line after <tokenLine>Use this token to access the HTTP API</tokenLine>.
telegramSetupConnectStep.successNotice: Token saved. The rest finishes on its own. Your assistant will confirm Telegram is delivering the next time you chat, and make sure it can reach you.

byoVoiceNote.body: Your assistant speaks through a provider you configured yourself. Set its voice on <link>Models & Services</link>.

systemPermissionsCard.title: System Permissions
systemPermissionsCard.accessibilityDescription: Allows your assistant to click, type, and control apps on your behalf.
systemPermissionsCard.screenDescription: Allows your assistant to capture screen context during computer-use tasks.
systemPermissionsCard.microphoneDescription: Allows your assistant to capture audio for voice input and recordings.
systemPermissionsCard.speechRecognitionDescription: Allows your assistant to transcribe your speech into text on-device.
systemPermissionsCard.speechRecognitionWindowsDescription: Allows your assistant to transcribe your speech into text with Windows speech recognition.
systemPermissionsCard.notificationsDescription: Allows your assistant to send macOS alerts for approvals, messages, and task updates.
systemPermissionsCard.notificationsWindowsDescription: Allows your assistant to show Windows notifications for approvals, messages, and task updates.
systemPermissionsCard.notificationBadgesDescription: Allows your assistant to show unseen conversation counts on the {surface}.
